name: Kuchioshi ~Ensa no Utage~
source:
An evil spirit haunted the old mansion.
Many people have died in that house, it was said.
Some students decided to test the rumors and sneaked in one night.
What awaited was beyond their imagination...
A fickle ghost with a desire to kill the mansion's evil spirit possessed Kakoto, a high school girl with supernatural senses, to force her into Kakoto's classmate's dreams and kill the evil spirit.
But this is no game. Human life is strangely linked to the body-hopping spirits.
Your choices are a matter of literal life and death for the protagonist and other humans.
Will Kakoto make it out happy, or even alive? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE087240.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
一座老旧宅邸遭到恶灵缠身，据说已有许多人死在其中。几名学生决定验证传闻，在某天夜里悄悄潜入宅邸。等待着他们的，却是远超想象的光景……

一只性情无常、渴望消灭宅邸恶灵的浮游灵，附身在具有灵感的女高中生歌琴身上。它强迫歌琴进入同学们的梦境，试图杀死那只恶灵。
但这并非游戏。人类的生命与不断换身附体的灵魂奇妙相连，玩家的每个选择，都会真正决定主人公和其他人的生死。
歌琴能否幸福地逃离此地——甚至能否活着离开？

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE087240.html]DLsite[/url]]
